zipPatch.name: extract-zip
zipPatch.limits: Controlled browser archives in a privately owned extraction directory. Not a claim of atomic containment against another local process concurrently replacing parents. Any patch drift, new advisory or other package blocks the gate. Remove this disposition only after a verified upstream fixed release and consumer regression.

thirdPartyLicenses.name: buffers
thirdPartyLicenses.basis: Debian's copyright record cites the upstream author's licensing commit 1b745ee35d33eb166e15ef1866073a07c6d7de87.
